title: Sonya Akulshina — a fuzzy pink name over full-bleed film
note: A director's site that opens on her reel playing edge to edge. Across the bottom third, "SONYA AKULSHINA" in a condensed grotesk fills the width in pale pink (about #F5C6F0) with soft, hairy edges, like ink bleeding into blotting paper or a heat haze, and a faint glow. It is a PNG (1830×500) laid over the video, not live text. The nav is one line of tiny caps in a white strip at the top centre: PERSONAL COMMISSIONED INFO CONTACT. Worth reusing: soft, organic type over moving image. The fuzz keeps a big name from looking digital, and it can be rebuilt with an SVG turbulence filter on real text.
